clean_repro.observed: All requests returned HTTP 200 with success; describe shows actual shardsNum=1 (default), invalid values silently ignored

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: HTTP request → handler_v2.go parseRequestBody → shardsNum parsing (no validation) → req.ShardsNum assignment → rootcoord service
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: REST v2 handler在解析shardsNum参数后完全没有做范围校验，直接将解析结果赋值给req.ShardsNum。虽然contract明文要求shardsNum >= 1，但源码没有任何对应检查，导致shardsNum=0、-1、65535等非法值被接受（实际使用时fallback到默认值1）。

falsification.probe: Describe created collection to verify actual shardsNum value
falsification.observed: Collections created with shardsNum=0/-1/65535 all show shardsNum=1 in describe response, confirming invalid values were silently defaulted rather than rejected

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API data type serialization - 8 issues in corpus; REST v2 and gRPC divergent validation: REST v2 accepting values the gRPC path rejects
cognition_match.note: 命中盲点指标: REST v2参数验证缺失是维护者已知的高频问题模式。shardsNum在REST v2层无校验，违反契约要求，属于典型的cross-channel inconsistency缺陷。

verdicts.rationale: REST v2 API接受违反契约的shardsNum值(0, -1, 65535)，返回HTTP 200成功但实际使用默认值1。契约明文要求shardsNum >= 1 (milvus_range_collections_create_002)，但源码handler_v2.go:2000-2006解析参数后完全没有范围校验。这是真缺陷：参数验证缺失允许非法值通过，违反文档契约。
